downstream_decision: Determine whether four time-separated public windows provide enough regime variation to retain, revise, or reject configured public-observable spread/depth bounds; no capability promotion is automatic.
hypothesis: Four deterministic 60-second BTC-USD public microstructure windows separated by six hours provide non-redundant message-rate, trade-rate, spread, and sequence-quality observations without credentials or capital.
required_gates_per_window: no authentication, order, signer, wallet, or capital effect
qualification_gate: All four immutable windows complete their per-window gates and at least two empirically distinct activity strata exist by preregistered descriptive features: unique message count, market-trade message count, and spread percentiles. Otherwise record insufficient regime diversity without adding windows automatically.
failure_gate: Any credential/account/order/signer/wallet/capital use, corrupted or non-replayable evidence, unexplained sequence failure, stale evidence, resource-bound breach, or mutation/reuse of an earlier stream ID.
stop_rule: Stop after four windows. Do not extend merely to obtain favorable distributions. A later schedule requires a new downstream decision and freeze.
